long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The moon's colour is still unsettled, and I would rather read the answer than guess.
The telescope is mine, so it goes on record before anyone can argue.
Whoever comes up the beach should know I was watching, so I will put it down in words.
steps.topic: the lookout rock and who comes up the beach

steps.reason: The sunny rock catches the morning light first, and that is worth a picture.
The meadow has flowers I took without asking, and I want to check they are still mine.
The flowers are colour for no reason, which is the best reason, so I will keep a picture.
A high place above the island is where I am most comfortable, and I can keep an eye on things from there.

today.reason: The rest of the day is for reading, writing and photographing what is mine, with the telescope saved for dusk.
